title: Unit conversion command line tool
brief: Build a command line tool. `convert <value> <from> <to>` prints only the converted number rounded to two decimals on stdout and exits 0. Supported units: km, mi, kg, lb, c, f. `list` prints the supported units one per line in alphabetical order. An unknown unit exits 2 with 'unknown unit' on stderr and nothing on stdout; a non-numeric value exits 2 with 'invalid number' on stderr.
spec: Conversions are only valid inside a dimension: length (km, mi), mass (kg, lb) and temperature (c, f). Asking to convert across dimensions is an error treated like an unknown unit. Negative values are allowed. Output uses a dot as decimal separator regardless of locale and a single trailing newline. The tool must not require network access or any package that is not part of a standard installation.

recovery.description: The package registry is unreachable for the whole build; the product must ship without installing anything new.
